en: A black‑and‑white street scene showing a large parade or public procession moving through a broad, tree‑lined avenue in a European city. Crowds in early‑20th‑century clothing line both sides of the street and fill a cobbled square in the foreground, while cavalry and people on horseback ride along the avenue. Multi‑story stone and brick buildings with ornate facades stand on both sides; on the right corner building many people watch from balconies and windows. Shop signage can be seen at street level. At the top center of the image, the handwritten year '1918' is visible.
